This was a safety-focused Phase 1 trial with no biomarker or PD readouts to assess whether any of the multiple compounds in this complex combination regimen engaged their intended targets. 2. PATHWAY MODULATION: No pathway biomarker data available to assess whether any of the proposed mechanisms (DNA damage, angiogenesis inhibition, checkpoint blockade, immune activation) were modulated. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: The primary endpoint was safety (Number of Participants With Adverse Events), not efficacy. Only 3 participants were enrolled before the study was halted prematurely. No efficacy endpoints were measured or reported. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: With only 3 participants enrolled, no subgroup analysis was possible or meaningful. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This trial failed due to operational issues - it was halted prematurely with only 3 participants enrolled out of what was presumably a much larger planned enrollment. The study was terminated for administrative/operational reasons rather than safety concerns, as only injection site erythema was reported. This represents a recruitment failure that prevented any meaningful assessment of the therapeutic hypothesis.
